test_title: PYST 02: SSC Stenographer 2025: English Language & Comprehension (Held On: 06 Aug, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

He is afraid _______ snakes.
solution:
The correct answer is '**of**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The preposition "**of**" is used to indicate fear or apprehension towards something.
 
• In this context, the subject "**He**" is expressing fear towards "**snakes**", making "**of**" the most appropriate choice.
 
• **Options 1, 3**, and **4** are grammatically incorrect in this context.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

**Complete Sentence:** *"He is afraid **of**__ snakes."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "to"** is incorrect because "afraid" is not followed by "to" in this context.
 
• **Option 3: "with"** is incorrect as it does not fit the grammatical structure of the sentence.
 
• **Option 4: "for"** is incorrect because it conveys a different meaning, unrelated to fear.
